entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: ApiCrudListProducts, ApiCrudListProducts #63026
  • Add in-build metric for Kestrel rejecting requests #63022
  • FileExtensionContentTypeProvider returns no content type for .msg files #63019

Closed

  • install .net8.0 aot 'Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Filters.AddResponseHeadersFilter' could not be located #53125
  • Please update npm package as it still has "ws": "^7.4.5" and not "ws": "^7.5.10". vulnerability issue #59996
  • Missing @microsoft/signalr TypeScript client package in version 9.x.x #63021
  • Some Jwt Bearer unit tests are failing in specific local time zones #62774
  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #63015
  • Perf regression: ApiCrudGetProductDetails #63016
  • Perf regression: updates #63014
  • Why won't rewriting after integration overwrite the previous one in Authorize? But an addition? #61662
  • OpenApi generates the same schema for generic types with a JsonConverterFactory. #59172
    Backlog
  • HttpContext in Blazor Web App .net 8 Render Interactive Auto Stay null in production #62948
  • Blazor WASM only relies on the current culture (current UI culture isn't respected) #56824
    Backlog
  • How to reference assets using new `Assets[]` syntax in RCL? #62847
  • OIDC - Setting the proxy to BackchannelHttpHandler does not make all calls pass through the proxy #62708
  • [Routing] EndpointGroupName can't be inherited #61757
  • OpenAPI: No support for detecting which endpoints access Request.Body for streaming purposes #62971
  • OpenAPI: Delta<> From OData days generates really weird. #62973
  • [OpenAPI] Duplicated object definitions in openapi spec #62154
  • [OpenApi] FromForm parameters with [Description] Attribute not include the description text #62514

  • Add logging for OpenAPI schema default value type mismatches #63027
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add [Obsolete] attribute to WebHost class and IWebHost interface, convert sample apps to HostBuilder pattern #63024

    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal, 10.0-rc1

    10.0-rc1

    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1

    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
